audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 3 and 4 read Skill while the whys under them say Ambessa wins outright; row 6 read Ambessa while whys[6] and the 51.98% win rate say Vladimir. Packet chart is Ambessa x6 then Vladimir.
audit.why: The mirror audit spotted the same inverted tail on the Ambessa side and left it alone; the packet chart, the prose and the win rate all agree, so it can be fixed here.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3, 4 flipped to Ambessa and row 6 to Vladimir, in matched full/content pairs with ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere; the ultimate window was never priced.
audit.why: Public Execution is 130/115/100 at 1250 range, Cunning Sweep 14s, Lacerate 13s, Repudiation 18s, against a 28s Sanguine Pool. Those numbers decide when you can step up.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into phases[3], phases[4], spikes[0], spikes[1] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Repeating Dashes' is not an Ambessa ability and it is the tracked threat in fourteen fields. Her passive is Drakehound's Step. Public Execution was also called an execute — Riot's text is blink, suppress, slam, stun, with no threshold and no healing. Repudiation's shield and grounding were never mentioned.
audit.why: A fabricated ability name in the loading screen and focus line is the single most visible error on the page. Drakehound's Step also empowers her next attack, so the wind-up is the burst tell, not the ability cast.
audit.corrected: Tracked threat moved to Public Execution and Drakehound's Step named as the attack-reset tell; 'execute' replaced with suppress-then-slam; Repudiation's shield/grounding written into the do.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization and breakdown.late both prescribed early anti-heal 'because his healing fights your pattern'.
audit.why: Nothing in Riot's text for any Ambessa ability heals her. The kit file's heal flag on Public Execution contradicts the ability description, so the description wins.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal replaced with Zhonya's stasis as the answer to a landed Public Execution and Mercury's Treads for her stun.
